smoke_test.check: wrapper self-test (python wrapper.py) in the Legwork sandbox, network off

entrypoint: Optimize SVG files using the local svgo CLI (minify a file or an SVG string)

arguments.svg:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- drawn by hand for a test -->
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10"><title>Red square</title><rect width="10" height="10" fill="#ff0000"/></svg>

known_answer.derived_from: the input SVG fills its square with #ff0000, which svgo's default convertColors plugin rewrites to its shortest form, the name red; svgo 4's default preset no longer removes <title>, so the title written into the input survives
